onset.Description: Onset of the event, relative to the first volume of the run.

Levels.congruent: Audiovisual clip in which the auditory and visual streams come from the same event.
Levels.incongruent: Audiovisual clip in which the auditory and visual streams come from different events.

stim_path.Description: Path of the stimulus file presented on this trial, relative to the stimulus set. n/a for inter-trial intervals.
